title: Long runs of integers with small prime factors and the divisor function of $n!$
summary: Let $d$ be the divisor function, and let $K(n)$ be the least positive integer $K$ for which $d((n + K)!) \ge 2d(n!)$. Erdős, Graham, Ivić and Pomerance proved that, for infinitely many $n$, \begin{equation*} K(n) > (1/9)(\log n)(\log_{2} n)(\log_{4} n)/(\log_{3} n)^3. \end{equation*} We improve upon this by a factor of order $\log_{3} n$, which brings the bound to the same order as Rankin's 1938 lower bound for gaps between consecutive primes.
